ranking: Native sigmoid(raw logit), or softmax over all20; fused=(1-alpha)*model_weight+alpha*exp(-error^2/(2*sigma^2)); ties smaller original ID
acceptance: Default score_reject: among environment-eligible candidates with defined direction, propose maximum fused score; accept only when score > rejection_threshold. Equality rejects. No hard direction tolerance.
historical_rule: direction_tolerance + softmax reproduces previous angular-gate selection; not the default.

calibration.reason: No completed independent accept/reject annotations; the included 112-request template remains blank.
calibration.sensitivity_scope: Current scene and current command only; alpha-rho response is not success rate or parameter optimization.

fallback: unsupported intent: highest model logit among environment-eligible candidates; none: null trajectory and stop_requested

command_input.angle_deg: relative to current ego forward; left positive; 0 is forward, not stop

safety_modes.current_environment_prediction: Current HD map + static actors fixed + dynamic actors translated by current absolute velocity at each matching future time, with fixed heading. Sampled constant-velocity prediction, not official DAC/TTC or a validated dynamic safety guarantee. Unknown dynamic velocity fails closed.
safety_modes.current_environment_geometry: Frozen-current-actor comparison only: current HD map + all current actor footprints fixed in space. This deliberately freezes moving actors too; not an appropriate general future collision model.
safety_modes.offline_pdm: Existing NC/DAC/TTC used as a retrospective oracle-like gate for comparison; unavailable to an online controller.

motion_prediction.model: current absolute velocity, constant translation, fixed actor yaw
motion_prediction.time_frame: all future times expressed in the current fixed ego rear-axle frame
motion_prediction.uncertainty: no calibrated prediction uncertainty; fixed 0.1 m vehicle margin only
